rule: Start at five $100 lots. At the first entry decision after the ETH sleeve's marked equity has reached a new $100 profit step, manually and permanently raise the configured lot by $20: $600->5x$120, $700->5x$140, and so on. Never lower the configured lot after a drawdown. Each actual order remains limited by the shared free cash, so a final slot buys the remaining amount if it is smaller than the configured lot.
